narrative.northStar: A calm, dependable accounting operations console.
narrative.overview: Ledger modern centers the Accounting team's daily queue. A graphite sidebar frames a pale canvas, aubergine marks primary actions, and teal distinguishes supporting financial context.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite navigation, aubergine primary, teal chart secondary

rules.name: Queue first
rules.body: Keep the daily work queue ahead of supporting metrics.

rules.name: Graphite & Aubergine
rules.body: Use graphite (`#292730`, `--sidebar`) for persistent navigation and aubergine (`#705080`, `--primary`) for primary actions and focus. Keep the canvas pale (`#F7F5F8`, `--background`), surfaces white (`#FFFFFF`, `--card`), and borders quiet (`#DFD8E3`, `--border`). Teal (`#347C88`, `--chart-1`, aliased by `--teal`) is the secondary chart accent, not semantic success; aubergine is also available as `--chart-2`. The soft teal token follows `--accent` (`#E7F0F2`). These documented colors follow the normative `:root` tokens in `src/app/globals.css`, not legacy hardcoded component colors. Preserve semantic success, warning, and error treatments: green for actual successful, validated, or completed states, amber for due attention, and red for errors. A green check is only for an actual successful, validated, or completed state.

rules.name: Accessible bar charts
rules.body: Use lazy-loaded Chart.js bar charts through react-chartjs-2, with accessible expandable data tables so values are available without relying on the canvas, color, or hover.

rules.name: Actual versus baseline
rules.body: Actual versus baseline bar charts use aubergine for actual and teal for baseline, with explicit series labels and monthly/YTD modes.

rules.name: Signed contributors
rules.body: Contributor charts use signed horizontal bars around zero to distinguish positive and negative contributions; preserve signs and values in the expandable data table.

rules.name: Capacity is progress
rules.body: Capacity tracks are progress indicators, not Chart.js charts.

rules.name: Source visible
rules.body: Make provenance and simulation status visible.

rules.name: Respect motion preference
rules.body: Disable nonessential motion when reduced motion is requested.

dos: Keep the work queue as the first dashboard module.
Show data period and simulation status.
donts: Use sparkle motifs or decorative icon grids.
Use checkmarks outside successful, validated, or completed states.
